description: We are going to conquer Mars for Odin!
summary: In this game, you play as a astronaut maintaining a Mars base through mini games. Clean solar panels and maintain your shelter and help humanity begin to thrive on Mars!
details:
This interactive game developed in Godot is intended to show children firsthand the challenges of maintaining a human presence on Mars.
